items.summary: Recommend rejecting new monetization, spend, and capacity admissions this cycle. Revenue is not decision-grade: Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission only for 2026-09-21, with all commission in an unattributed aggregate row. September AI spend is $1,002.46 across 5,531 calls, so no site-level contribution margin, ROI, payback, or forecast is supportable. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only after capacity clears, measured on registered affiliate clicks; do not claim revenue lift. The 14,734 impressions, 150 clicks, 1,021 sessions, and 17 conversions are operating/vanity metrics until linked to attributable cash revenue and costs.

Maintain containment and do not authorize new spend or monetization expansion. Minimum finance evidence for contribution margin is: provider revenue by site and date, AI cost by site and date, infrastructure/hosting cost by site or allocable fleet basis, and any affiliate/network fees. Current margin is not calculable because revenue covers one day, $4.92 is unattributed, and infrastructure and other direct costs are absent. Provide read-only billing exports or owner-supplied totals; no banking access or payment changes are requested.
